cards.title: Constraints Birth Ingenuity
cards.insight: The most innovative solutions emerge when creators face meaningful limitations—whether time, resources, or space. Boundaries force prioritization and eliminate unnecessary complexity, paradoxically expanding the range of novel approaches.
cards.takeaway: Set deliberate constraints on your next project: limit tools, time, or scope to unlock unexpected creative directions.

cards.title: Remixing Over Invention
cards.insight: True creativity rarely starts from zero; it recombines existing elements in fresh configurations. The ability to see unexpected connections between unrelated ideas distinguishes breakthrough thinking from incremental work.
cards.takeaway: Practice cross-disciplinary exploration—study how solutions in one field could transform another, building your remixing muscle.

cards.title: Iteration as Discovery
cards.insight: The creative process is rarely linear; each attempt reveals what you didn't know, informing the next cycle. Embracing rapid iteration—and failure—is how ideas mature from rough impulse to refined execution.
cards.takeaway: Ship early prototypes and gather feedback often; treat each cycle as research, not judgment.

cards.title: Permission to Be Weird
cards.insight: The impulse to conform dilutes originality. Creative work that resonates often feels slightly unfamiliar or off-norm at first—it disrupts expectation in ways that linger. The discomfort signals novelty.
cards.takeaway: Identify one aspect of your work that feels 'too different' and lean into it deliberately.
